Title: Durable Functions v2.3 is now available

Body.Content:
The Durable Functions extension for Azure Functions just released a large update with version 2.3. This includes support for enabling geo-redundant durable functions, long running timers and scheduled events, and improvements to logging and scale.

Full details of the announcement can be found on GitHub
